findings.title: Identity report loses independent token-close failure presence when its code is zero
findings.condition: A TokenUserError::Cleanup or native observation error carries numeric code 0. No actual Win32 zero-last-error failure was reproduced.
findings.observation: record_token_error records only the close code; close-zero plus query-5 produces the same report as query-5 alone. Query-zero and close-only-zero reports violate the declared identity schema.
findings.consequence: Cleanup failure evidence is lost, or the Go decoder returns invalid observation rather than the typed failure receipt; no false admission was established.
findings.native_applicability: All listed files are byte-identical at efa73; condition and consequence remain source-level.
findings.next_acceptance: Choose an explicit compatible representation and add conversion-level native-zero, close-only-zero and dual-error zero cases while preserving callback/admission/custody rules.

findings.title: Base ABI encodes native-zero and cleanup-zero outcomes rejected by its own schema
findings.condition: io::Error has Some(0), or a typed cleanup failure has code 0. Native occurrence is not established.
findings.observation: failure emits MH_NATIVE with zero code; encode_settlement sets a failed-slot mask with a zero slot code. Header and Go decoder require nonzero codes for both forms.
findings.consequence: The Go result decoder discards the Outcome as invalid, losing a validated root/cleanup receipt. Release still honors an independently cleared owner slot; no custody loss or automatic retry is inferred.
findings.native_applicability: Encoder/header/Go files are byte-identical. windows.rs termination/close text is unchanged, shifted seven lines by the window-policy insertion.
findings.next_acceptance: Add encoder/decoder zero-code cases, preserve raw failure presence and no-retry/cleared-slot custody, and settle wire compatibility explicitly.

findings.title: Loader rejection drops a subsequent FreeLibrary failure and unresolved module custody
findings.condition: LoadLibraryExW succeeded; required symbol resolution or ABI version rejects the DLL; subsequent FreeLibrary returns false.
findings.observation: bridge_open ignores FreeLibrary return and frees its bridge storage, returning only the original load/admission error.
findings.consequence: Secondary unload failure is lost; no Library/retained module capability is returned to account for unresolved module reference.
findings.native_applicability: Entire Go bridge file is byte-identical at efa73.
findings.next_acceptance: Preserve primary and secondary errors with explicit unresolved-module disposition; separate synthetic and native-failure evidence.

findings.severity: medium for evidence claims; no production failure established
findings.title: Ordinary shared teardown accepts cleanupFailed without failing the test
findings.condition: An ordinary test relies on own() teardown and Finish returns err=nil with Outcome.State=cleanupFailed; no earlier body assertion requires complete. Example: TestCheckedAdmissionNilPolicyDoesNotConsumeAdmission ends at admission_windows_test.go:158.
findings.observation: own() explicitly accepts both complete and cleanupFailed, releases the allocation, and does not t.Error the unexpected cleanup failure. Library.Close can then succeed although failed native handle close remains recorded in Outcome.
findings.consequence: A PASS from such a test does not establish successful native cleanup. The cleanupFailed state is intentionally expected in native fault tests, so removing it globally would break their deliberate contract.
findings.native_applicability: Entire affected Go test file is byte-identical at efa73.
findings.next_acceptance: If a change is later authorized, make ordinary teardown require complete and keep an explicit expected-cleanup-failure helper for fault cases. Preserve historical native outcomes. No new test or production edit performed.

findings.severity: low; failure-path bound depends on outer process owner
findings.title: EOF timeout path closes the endpoint then waits without a remaining bound
findings.condition: The 3-second EOF timer fires and endpoint Close or the worker fails to finish.
findings.observation: Timeout branch executes endpoint Close then a bare receive from done with no remaining deadline.
findings.consequence: The per-test watchdog does not guarantee bounded cleanup; outer go test/process deadline remains the eventual guard. No hang was executed or observed in this review.
findings.native_applicability: Entire affected Go test file is byte-identical at efa73.
findings.next_acceptance: Do not count the 3-second local timer alone as proof of bounded reader completion. Any eventual repair should retain the same reader and endpoint, preserve timeout status and avoid a new unrelated completion observer.
